provenance.note: 2026-08-23-4's stored shot stamped as a parser_version 1 read of the bay layout: fields_present is hd_golf's declared fields less bounce_and_roll (the bay layout has no Bounce & Roll tile), and raw_fields is the stored one plus Smash Factor and Impact Position V, both '' (smash_factor set to null to match, and the warnings say so). So two shown-only tiles: Club Speed holding 103.6, and Smash Factor printed and blank. Neither is refused and neither reaches a row: tile_refusals judges analysed fields alone, and the analysed view blanks both. The three analysed tiles with nothing under the label, Spin, Spin Axis and Impact Position V, are printed_blank, in hd_golf's declared order and P3's wording, then 2026-08-23-4's flight refusal. Every field the stored shot holds a value for is in fields_present, so the analysed view is the stored shot's, and measurements are 2026-08-23-4's recorded shot and flight rows with Python's values. Right-handed, loft 30.5, as the vector carries them; no photo hash, so photo_sha256 is null.
